subject: business-studies
title: Lewin's Change Model
welcome_lead: Unfreeze the old, change, refreeze the new - Lewin's classic three steps.
meta_desc: A-Level Change: Lewin's three-stage change model and force field.
final_note: Resistance fades when staff see why change matters and feel safe to move.

concepts.def: Preparing the organisation to accept change is needed.
Embedding the change in culture and systems.
Tool comparing forces for and against change.

walkthroughs.body_html: Lewin likens organisations to ice blocks. You must unfreeze assumptions, change to the new state, then refreeze - otherwise the firm slides back to old habits.
List driving and restraining forces and rate their strength. To change, either increase driving forces or - usually more effective - reduce restraining forces.
Most failures occur at refreeze. Without new metrics, rewards and stories, staff drift back to old practices. Embedding takes months and explicit reinforcement.
